about: Movie and series servers, in the order the web app offers them. Measured from Kenya on 2026-10-25 on Matlock (2024) S1E1, reading the picture actually decoded and the bitrate of the stream: VidRock 1080p at 5 Mb/s (also 720p, 360p), VidZee 1080p at about 3 Mb/s (one rendition only), VidLink Pro 1080p at only 1.6 Mb/s (also 720p, 480p; it was showing 720p after 40 s). On the web VidZee leads because it is the only one that runs inside the Ad Shield sandbox (no pop-ups). In the Android app, where Sahrae plays the stream in its own player without the provider page, the order is by bitrate instead (cleanFirst in services/cleanStream.ts).

servers.name: VidZee · 1080p · 5.1
servers.note: Matlock S1E1 at 1920x1080, about 3 Mb/s H.264, one rendition (never drops), 5.1 AAC. The only server that plays inside the web Ad Shield sandbox.

servers.name: VidRock · 1080p · sharpest
servers.note: Matlock S1E1: renditions 1080p at 5.0 Mb/s, 720p at 3.0, 360p at 0.8; showing 1080p after 34 s. The clearest picture measured. Slow to start (up to ~20 s). Refuses the web sandbox.

servers.name: Viduki · 1080p
servers.note: The same stream as VidZee (about 3 Mb/s 1080p) through a different front end: a backup for when VidZee's own player is down. Refuses the web sandbox.

servers.name: VidLink Pro · up to 1080p
servers.note: Matlock S1E1: renditions 1080p at only 1.6 Mb/s (HEVC), 720p at 0.8, 480p at 0.3; showing 720p after 40 s, and it starts at 480p. The softest picture of the four, so last. Refuses the web sandbox.
